a.name: Tick run
a.description: The eight trust items as one wrapping run of ticked words under a serif lead, ruled above and below on the bone page.
a.differs_from: A running ticked line between two rules, with no photo, tiles or card; London's pick is a carded photo ledger and the built strips are plain or carded columns.

b.name: Puppy folder
b.description: The five papers as slips in a tabbed brass folder; beside it, deposit, delivery or collection, inset in one soft steel panel.
b.differs_from: The papers are drawn as a folder of slips inside an inset panel, split from the three handover steps beside it; London's pick is a carded two-column ledger with a photo.

c.name: Seal sheet
c.description: Eight brass-ringed seals in a 4x2 sheet beside a kicker column on a full-width steel band; London's seal band, re-laid.
c.differs_from: Refresh delta, layout: London's centred kicker over one six-across row becomes a kicker column beside a 4x2 sheet of eight seals. Differs from London's pick on all four axes.
